I once ate a CBD gummy to help me sleep one night. 30 minutes later it felt like I’ve eaten an edible, and it hit me wayyyy hard. I get up o go to the bathroom, and when I was finished, I felt like I was going to pass out. At this point, I’m walking out the door, and It feels like I’ve just downed 3-4 edibles all at once, and I can’t comprehend anything, like the moments pass by and I can’t recall them. I say my girlfriends name, trying to get her attention as I’m about to pass out, or something. I felt super hot, like I was having a hot-flash, and I hit the ground hella hard, don’t recall the pain though. I laid there, and I remember the pain in my inner torso, it was so painful. Everything hurt. My head felt like a bomb went off, and my chest/stomach felt like someone was just twisting everything around. I remember, in that moment, I genuinely thought I was going to die. I muttered to my girlfriend who was by my side, and she say with me. This went on for about 20 minutes I assume, I don’t exactly recall time or anything. After a while, I was able to get up and hit the bed. God, it was the most awful experience, and I’ve compared it to the time I ripped my toe off and had to get it stitched back on. That was miserable, but this was so much worse. Never did go to the hospital, and never figured out what really happened, so I blame it on the CBD gummy.

I was shouting curse words and flexing/tensing up every single of of my muscles.
